name: Rex Sealing & Packing Industries Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1963, Rex Sealing & Packing Industries Ltd is a manufacturer and exporter 
of Sealing packing and Insulation products[1]
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1][2]
a) Jointing Sheets
b) Fabric Expansion Joints
c) Gland Packing & Ropes
d) High Temperature Resistant Textiles
e) Ceramic Fibre Product
f) Insulation Jackets
g) Silica & Silicone Products
h) Graphite Sheets Rings
i) Vermiculite Coated
j) Tadpole Gasket

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 11.6% over last 3 years.
